{{Top}}
[[File:ThreepioMagnetized-BJ.png|thumb|right|250px|C-3PO caught by a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] magnet crane]]
A '''magnet''' was a type of device that attracted things to itself,<ref name="HV">{{Ewoks|The Haunted Village}}</ref> including some metals, such as [[Iron/Legends|iron]].<ref name="XWA website">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' at the [[LucasArts]] Entertainment Company website {{C|[https://web.archive.org/web/20060320083516/www.lucasarts.com/products/alliance/xwa_characters.htm Backup link to page]}}</ref> Magnets could be used to seal things, such as doors.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

An [[Electromagnet/Legends|electromagnet]] was a type of magnet in which the magnetic field was produced by the flow of electric current.

[[Logray/Legends|Logray]] once compared a magnet's powers to [[Shadowroot soap]]'s tendency to attract [[Fly/Legends|flies]].<ref name="HV" />

[[QT-KT/Legends|QT-KT]] possessed a remote-controlled magnet to deal with several floating [[Bomb/Legends|bombs]].<ref name="Secret Weapons">{{TCW|Secret Weapons}}</ref>
